{"name":"a24f1d7ab170216be04d","layouts":[{"id":0,"position":{"x":0,"y":732,"z":5000,"width":1013,"height":211,"tabOrder":5000}}],"singleVisual":{"visualType":"textbox","drillFilterOtherVisuals":true,"objects":{"general":[{"properties":{"paragraphs":[{"textRuns":[{"value":""}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"A separate initiative was instigated for Gloucestershire Dialysis patients whereby patients can use their own (or family / friends) transport, and then claim mileage back from the the ICB under the Dialysis Mileage Reimbursement Scheme (DMRS).  This has proved viable, with a strong cohort of patients utilising this service.  Data is collected from the claims database held by the ICB, and is reported under the tab \"DMRS\".  Please note that, as patients submit claims covering more than one journey, it is not possible to accurately assign them to a journey month; therefore the activity has been assigned to the month that the claim was received by the ICB and sent on to Finance for payment, to align activity with cost.","textStyle":{"fontSize":"11pt"}}]},{"textRuns":[{"value":"Data is shown on the DMRS tab from the start of this initiative to monitor trends and the potential positive impact on the main journeys for dialysis patients.  The maximum mileage that a standard journey should take has been ascertained for each journey, and patients can claim up to that number of miles and be paid at the following rates: ","textStyle":{"fontSize":"11pt"}}]}]}}]},"vcObjects":{"border":[{"properties":{"show":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}},"color":{"solid":{"color":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"'#00AB99'"}}}}},"radius":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"9D"}}}}}],"title":[{"properties":{"show":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}},"text":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"'Dialysis Mileage Re-imbursement Scheme (DMRS)'"}}},"background":{"solid":{"color":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"'#00AB99'"}}}}},"bold":{"expr":{"Literal":{"Value":"true"}}}}}]}}}
